character.name: Idle
character.prompt: 16-bit pixel art knight character, 3/4 top-down perspective, heavy silver plate armor, closed visor helmet, holding a steel broadsword and iron tower shield, 4-directional sprite sheet layout (north, south, east, west), clean pixel boundaries.

rows.animation:
16-bit pixel art knight, 3/4 top-down perspective, 64x64 pixel grid, clean outlines. Provide a 4-directional animated sprite sheet layout (facing North, South, East, West) containing the following matching sequence:
- Row 1: Idle loop, gentle up-and-down breathing bob.
- Row 2: Jogging loop, running with heavy armor footstep pacing.
- Row 3: Sword Swing, attacking with a sharp 180-degree horizontal broadsword arc.
- Row 4: Shield Thrust, forcefully slamming the iron tower shield forward.
- Row 5: Shield Block, crouching low, bracing behind the tower shield firmly.
- Row 6: Ground Smash, jumping slightly and slamming the sword down hard into the floor grid.
